name: Local Agent
description: Ed25519-signed local Agent pairing, scoped SSH jobs, sessions and SFTP. Sudo disabled in this beta.
features: Signed local device enrollment with explicit host and action permissions
SSH jobs, sessions and SFTP via the Termix core SSH pipeline
Durable job/session recovery and signed legacy /agent/v1 requests
HTTPS default; optional trusted private IPv4 CIDRs
Sudo execution disabled pending an audited core SDK capability

env.name: CLOUDSSH_AGENT_HTTP_POLICY_LOCKED
env.description: Lock transport rules to deployment environment variables

env.name: CLOUDSSH_AGENT_ALLOW_HTTP
env.description: Allow trusted local HTTP when the policy is locked

env.name: CLOUDSSH_AGENT_HTTP_ALLOWED_CIDRS
env.description: Comma-separated trusted private IPv4 CIDRs for locked policy
